fixed_baseline_selection: Choose the smallest efSearch whose independent 500-query certification one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB for P(Recall@10 < 0.90) is <= 0.05; if none qualifies, use efSearch=200 as fixed-safe fallback.
darth_certification: Accept frozen DARTH only if its independent 500-query one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson risk UCB is <= 0.05; otherwise reject and deploy the fixed-safe fallback without changing the DARTH model or stopping rule.
evaluation_rule: The 1000-query evaluation role is used once for reporting and cannot select efSearch, retrain a model, or change certification.
secondary_target: Recall@10 = 1.00 is descriptive in M1; it does not replace the primary 0.90 safety gate.
